plan.summary: When their regional train stops at the transfer station, Marta waits in front of the exit door expecting it to open automatically. After waving at the glass and wondering if she has to shout, Lukas points out the glowing green door button. Marta presses it firmly herself, releasing the sliding doors with a satisfying pneumatic hiss.
plan.cliffhanger: Safely on the platform, Marta looks up at the big electronic departure board to spot their next track.
plan.visual_hook: Marta stands expectantly before the closed train exit door, frantically waving both hands at the glass like at an automatic supermarket entrance.
plan.everyday_problem: Marta expects the regional train doors to slide open automatically upon arrival at the station.
plan.practical_resolution: Lukas directs her attention to the illuminated door-open button, and Marta presses it herself to open the door.
plan.marta_goal: Open the train exit door so she and Lukas can exit at their transfer stop.
plan.marta_decision: Marta locates the glowing circular button on the door frame and presses it firmly with her palm.
plan.visual_payoff: The green ring illuminates brightly, pneumatic air hisses softly, and the double doors part smoothly as Marta steps forward with a proud smile.

creative_review.previous_weakness_addressed: Used an animated environmental cue with glowing button illumination and door motion instead of dialogue-heavy instructions.
